Sure! Below are three quick ways you can put a “Netflix Subscription Reminder” on your calendar for **March 27** (or whatever device/calendar you prefer). Pick whichever method feels easiest for you: --- ### 📅 Method 1 – Add a Calendar Event (Google / Apple / Microsoft) | Platform | Steps | |----------|-------| | **Google Calendar** | 1️⃣ Go to .
2️⃣ Click the big “+ Create” button.
3️⃣ Title → *“Check Netflix Subscription”*
4️⃣ Date → *Mar‑27–[this year]*.
5️⃣ Time → pick when you’d like to get reminded (e.g., 9 AM).
6️⃣ Under “Add notification”, choose “Email” or “Pop‑up” at X minutes/hours before.
7️⃣ Save. | | **Apple Calendar** | 1️⃣ Open Calendar.app.
2️⃣ Double‑click Mar‑27.
3️⃣ Enter title & time.
4️⃣ Right‑click → “Alert…”. Choose alert type/time.
5️⃣ Done. | | **Outlook Calendar** | 1️⃣ File ➜ New ➜ Appointment.
2️⃣ Subject → *“Netflix Sub Check”*.
3️⃣ Start/End dates → Mar‑27.
4️⃣ Set reminder under “Reminder” dropdown.
5️⃣ Send/Save. | --- ### ⏰ Method 2 – Windows Scheduled Task (if you’re comfortable with a bit more tech) If you’d rather let Windows pop up a dialog box right before the day arrives, you can create a scheduled task that runs a small batch file showing a toast notification. ```bat @echo off msg %USERNAME% "⚡️ Remember: Renew Netflix subscription today!" ``` #### How to schedule it: 1. Press **Win + R**, type `taskschd.msc`, hit **Enter**. 2. In the left pane click **Action ► Create Basic Task…**. 3. Name → *“Netflix Remind”*, Next. 4. Trigger → **Daily**, start date → **03/27/YYYY**, repeat once per day. 5. Action → **Start a program** → Browse → select the `.bat` file above. 6. Finish. When the task triggers, you'll see a popup message reminding you about Netflix. *(Tip: If you don’t want a console window popping up, replace `msg` with a PowerShell toast notification.)* --- ### 📝 Method 3 – Sticky Notes / Desktop Widget Sometimes a plain sticky note works best—just pin it to your desktop so you’ll see it daily. 1. Search for **Sticky Notes** in the Start menu. 2. Type *“Renew Netflix subscription – Mar‑27”*. 3. Pin the note to the top-left corner of your screen. Or install a third‑party widget such as [Rainmeter](http://www.rainmeter.net/) and configure a custom text display. --- ## Quick Checklist - ✅ Decide which platform suits you most. - ✅ Input the correct date (`03/27/[current year]`). - ✅ Set a reminder/alarm one hour/day ahead (optional). - ✅ Test the reminder (create a test event first) to ensure it pops up correctly. Let me know if you'd like help setting this up on a specific platform—or if you need a ready‑to‑run script for another OS!
